serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: Do you see him?
Bot: Here he comes! And so is my arm!
Old Man: Kyah!!! {{punch}}Help! An arm is chasing me!
Bot: We really gave him a scare! 
You: Get your arm back and let’s get out of here. 
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.shock
Policeman: Where?! Where is it?! I always wanted to see a ghost!
Policewoman: Don’t get your hopes up, it’s probably just some stupid prank.
You: W-Why is the police here?!
Bot: The old guy had to call them after what he saw on his TV!
You: What did you show him?! Whatever we gotta get out of here!
Bot: W-What about my arm?!
You: Forget about it! It’s more important that they don’t see you without one!
